published_prior_art.cite: ClasonLorenzMahlerWirth2021: entropy-regularized KKT/Bregman reduction is standard, though not this Gaussian game.
KitagawaLeeQiu2026: two-point least-favorable prior and posterior-probability logit under mean-square regret, not reverse-KL assignment loss.
Weed2018: finite linear-program entropic face control, not residual Gaussian face experiments or their minimax risks.
HiranoPorter2009: the binary zero-temperature Gaussian treatment-rule reduction is established; this is a normalization check for the new loss.
KitagawaLeeQiu2026: scalar unconstrained logistic minimaxity, not finite-risk characterization of coordinatewise capacity-coupled scalings.
SunadaIzumi2025: capacity-constrained average optimality, not a globally minimax reverse-KL rule compatible across exposed faces or a certificate algorithm.
HiranoPorter2009: LAN treatment-rule lower-bound architecture; exact-capacity reverse-KL embedding is the proposed adaptation.
AtheyWager2021 and HiranoPorter2009 provide observational policy learning and local decision transfer, but not covariance-stable exact-capacity attainment across active-face changes.
WhitehouseAusternSyrgkanis2026 studies inference for unconstrained maximum-type policy values; it does not cover exact-capacity coupled maps or policy-map KL neighborhoods.

novelty_flags.label: SunadaIzumi2025 comparisons in comparator_promise_table, related_work, and seed:face-compatible-global-minimax
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited arXiv version's relevant average-optimality result is Theorem 3.2, not “Theorem 1”; correct the theorem locator while retaining the substantive average-versus-minimax distinction.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Questions 1–3
novelty_flags.one_line: Sun2026, already listed in the bibliography, is a closer published constrained-policy comparator and must be explicitly distinguished: it studies welfare maximization with estimated budget/cost constraints, whereas this proposal assumes supplied p and q and targets a local reverse-KL minimax game.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5
soundness_flags.one_line: P is defined as an observed-data law but the claimed conditional exponential tilt, its full-data causal extension, its Radon–Nikodym derivative, and the finite-sample Regret_n functional are not specified, so preservation of p and propensities and the stated LAN comparison are not yet defined claims.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2
soundness_flags.one_line: The learner handle leaves the nuisance estimators and their training rule unspecified, so the displayed map \widehat\gamma and the uniform attainment target do not name one definite procedure.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 3
soundness_flags.one_line: The welfare coordinate of \mathcal C_n, the expected-KL policy-neighborhood radius, and the metric and lower bound meant by “nondegenerate diameter” are unspecified.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Questions 2–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The causal upper and inference claims are restricted to fixed m, known target masses and quota, and one fixed local contact set; they do not cover unknown target masses or changing contact sets.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any attainment or coverage result is conditional on this fixed-contact, known-capacity regime.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3.2 states conditional average optimality for sequences matched by a limit-experiment rule minimizing the limiting posterior loss; the conclusion separately frames asymptotic minimax optimality as a conjectural differentiability-sensitive direction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Write an explicit full-data model and normalized conditional tilt, then display Regret_n as the finite-sample oracle objective gap and prove that the path preserves each claimed primitive.
Replace generic off-fold nuisances by clipped empirical finite-cell means and propensities, or state exact foldwise rate and measurability conditions for a named learner.
Add Sun2026 to related work and a boundary proposition showing why its estimated-budget impossibility does not subsume the supplied-p, supplied-q exact-capacity regime.
After repairing the model, elevate the certificate target by specifying the finite saddle-program encoding, truncation radius, number of face flags, and a polynomial bit-complexity proof route.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal probability model and all undefined inference/learner objects, then correct the Sunada locator and add the Sun2026 boundary comparison before Stage 0.
